name: Form and Material Exploration
description: Introduction to a wide range of physical manifestations used throughout a design process to simulate different aspects of a product’s appearance and function before it is produced. Understanding the appropriate use of mock-ups, models and prototypes at certain unique stages of the design process. Learning model making as a step-by-step method of producing models. Learning to work with linear and volumetric materials as appropriate aesthetic, formal and material simulations.
